procedure: Observer ephemeris query with COMMAND=10, CENTER=500@399, TLIST=2026-07-18 00:00, TIME_TYPE=UT, QUANTITIES=2,20, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, ANG_FORMAT=DEG, APPARENT=AIRLESS, RANGE_UNITS=AU, and EXTRA_PREC=YES.
timeScale: UTC output converted by Horizons from its internal TDB dynamics
frame: Airless apparent Earth equator and equinox of date, EOP-corrected IAU 1976/1980 as defined by Horizons
accuracy: Horizons extra-precision output. The legacy orb.js comparison intentionally uses the lower accuracy of its solar and frame models and omits several apparent-place corrections.
